title: Lead Finder
description: Find local businesses or Shopify stores, read their websites for contact details, and keep the ones you can actually reach.

form.title: New lead search
form.categoryPlaceholder: Type to search, e.g. staging, florist, interior
form.categoryHint: Pick a Google Business category from the suggestions.
form.noCategories: No matching categories. Try a shorter word.
form.locationHint: Small typos are fine. If the name matches several places, you pick one.
form.pickLocation: Several places match. Pick the one you mean:
form.noLocations: No place found. Check the spelling or add the city or country.
form.costNote: Pulling businesses uses a small amount of credits. Reading websites and checking emails is free.

list.title: Lead searches
list.emptyDescription: Start a search above to build your first lead list.

detail.skipped: {{count}} businesses were skipped because an earlier search already found them.
detail.deleteDescription: The search and all of its leads will be removed. Businesses in it can be found again by a new search.
detail.hiddenStores: {{count}} sites are hidden because they couldn't be confirmed as live Shopify stores (closed, password protected, moved off Shopify, or unreadable).
detail.shownStores: Showing {{count}} sites that couldn't be confirmed as live Shopify stores.

reachabilityHint.ready: An email was found and its domain accepts mail.
reachabilityHint.social_only: No email on the site. Reach them by phone, Instagram or WhatsApp.
reachabilityHint.email_unreachable: The site shows an email, but its domain can't receive mail.
reachabilityHint.no_contact: The website had no contact details we could read.
reachabilityHint.pending: The website hasn't been read yet.

table.siteUnreadableHint: The site blocked automated reading, timed out, or only renders with JavaScript. Check it by hand.

stores.keywordsHint: Comma separated. Matched against store titles and descriptions.
stores.maxRankHint: 0–1000 backlink rank. A lower limit leaves out big brands, e.g. 300.
stores.domainsHint: One per line or comma separated, up to 200. Duplicates and stores from earlier searches are skipped.
stores.costNote: About ${{cost}} of DataForSEO for the lookup. Reading stores and checking emails is free.
stores.importCostNote: Free: no lookup runs, only the stores' own pages are read.
